<!-- verdify-paused-handoff-20261012:787 -->
Jason's shutdown handoff: **implementation and delivery PAUSED; do not auto-resume.**

**Current state:** OPEN and PAUSED; no later acceptance receipt was established by this shutdown capture. The October11 clause assessment remains the prior boundary; any dated runtime/telemetry facts in it require refresh on resume.

**Prior clause assessment (October11, not a new runtime probe):** Whole-resource/overnight specification is preparation. Current partial meters, ambiguous shared water, absent gas/interiorDLI/calibration/cost do not support whole-resource or profit claims.

**Blockers:** Jason explicitly paused all implementation/delivery. Native blocking dependencies: VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#785, VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#781, VerdifyConsultancy/verdify-platform#410. The listed acceptance boundary remains unproved beyond linked historical receipts.

**Next step on explicit resume:** After explicit Jason resume, refresh exact source/live and predecessor evidence, then satisfy: Each claimed resource has eligible measured coverage and calibration/uncertainty; modeled proxies remain secondary.

**Acceptance retained:**
- [ ] Each claimed resource has eligible measured coverage and calibration/uncertainty; modeled proxies remain secondary.
- [ ] A new prospective study can test climate improvement and resource benefit as stated, or the claim is explicitly narrowed.
- [ ] No hardware purchase, gas tuning, yield/profit claim or seasonal controller expansion follows automatically from the current pilot.
